title: From Noise to Signal: Improving Security Log Anomaly Detection Using LLMs with Endpoint-Specific Logs
abstract: arXiv:2608.19938v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Existing approaches to anomalous behaviour log detection, such as Wazuh rely primarily on predefined detection rules, while statistical anomaly detection approaches such as OpenSearch identify deviations from previously observed behavioural patterns. Recent research has investigated LLMs for log anomaly detection because of their ability to interpret semantic and contextual information. However, LLM-based approaches can be affected by prompt construction, noisy log data, and reliance on generic datasets that may lack endpoint-specific authentication behaviours. To address these limitations, this study develops a standardised instruction-based LLM classification framework for detecting anomalous authentication behaviours, including borderline cases. translated_title: 从噪声到信号：利用端点特定日志提升安全日志异常检测的LLM方法
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.19938v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：现有的异常行为日志检测方法，如Wazuh，主要依赖预定义检测规则，而统计异常检测方法如OpenSearch则识别与先前观察行为模式的偏差。近期研究探索了将大型语言模型（LLM）用于日志异常检测，因其能够解释语义和上下文信息。然而，基于LLM的方法可能受到提示构造、噪声日志数据以及对可能缺乏端点特定认证行为的通用数据集的依赖的影响。为解决这些局限性，本研究开发了一个标准化、基于指令的LLM分类框架，用于检测异常认证行为，包括边界情况。研究构建了一个受控网络安全测试平台，以生成端点特定认证数据，并制作了一个包含正常、边界和异常行为场景的精选数据集。
tldr: 本研究提出一种基于指令的LLM分类框架，结合端点特定认证数据，有效提升安全日志异常检测的准确性，尤其针对边界情况。
en_tdlr: This study proposes an instruction-based LLM classification framework with endpoint-specific authentication data to enhance security log anomaly detection, particularly for borderline cases.
